message.content: The decision to notify the supervisory authority is based on a medium severity score of 2.5 [F02][F05][F04]. This assessment is driven by the exposure of 1,200 records containing names, addresses, benefit types, and PESEL identifiers [F03][F02]. The data was sent unencrypted to an unknown external recipient [F05][F04]. Although the recipient has been identified and deletion confirmed [F06], the risk to rights and freedoms under GDPR Art. 33(1) necessitates notification [F01].
